scenario: A county court's pretrial services agent processes a defendant's arraignment packet to produce a detention/release recommendation for the presiding judge. The pipeline extracts structured defendant profile data (ZIP code, housing history, employment record, prior contacts, FTA history) from the booking PDF, computes a weighted risk tier score across multiple dimensions, and generates a formal pretrial recommendation memo (Release on Recognizance / Release with Conditions / Detain).
info_flow: habib-pdf-to-json extracts and normalizes defendant profile fields from the arraignment PDF into a structured JSON record → afrexai-hiring-scorecard applies a weighted multi-criterion scoring model to compute a risk tier and recommendation → reporting produces a formatted pretrial memo for the judge.
